name: 女童格纹蕾丝领短袖连衣裙款
description: 粉蓝格纹蕾丝领女童连衣裙套图模版，白底到细节微距的转化节奏

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot grounds, pastel cloud-blue #C9E5EF and cream-yellow #F6E8C8 info grounds, warm light-grey #E3E1DD macro grounds
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft neutral studio light, front-left key with fill, gentle wrap, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth paper-textured backdrop and light wooden hanger rail
styleLock.iconSystem: flat pastel paper-cut cloud and sun shapes with thin-line icons, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: garment neatly pressed on a faceless child-size form or hanger, stable hero angle and scale across the set, frame cropped above the neckline
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent pastel childrenswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud blue #C9E5EF, cream yellow #F6E8C8, blush pink plaid accent #E88CA8 and deep navy text #2B3A67 with clean white #FFFFFF packshot grounds; bright soft neutral studio lighting with front-left key, gentle wrap and soft contact shadows; modern rounded geometric sans-serif; flat pastel paper-cut decorative shapes with thin-line icons; clean high-end childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic cards; stable hero product angle and scale with the garment always neatly pressed and framed above the neckline; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no cartoon character prints.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，白底合规干净
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level front view, garment on a faceless child-size dress form, frame cropped above the neckline
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow at the hem
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level front view, the garment neat and symmetric on a faceless child-size dress form with the frame cropped above the neckline and the full hem visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the hem. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. No extra whitespace. 8K commercial childrenswear quality. Negative: no model, no recognizable child face, no props, no hanger hardware, no watermark, no fake logo, no in-image text, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no fiber-content claims or percentages, no cut-off hem.

shots.intent: 一秒传达清爽可爱核心卖点，承接首图

shots.lighting: soft front-left key light with gentle wrap, soft contact shadow
shots.background: pastel cloud-blue #C9E5EF with flat paper-cut cloud and sun shapes
shots.props: flat paper-cut clouds and one flat sun shape in the upper field
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 38% for copy
shots.textZone: right-side copy zone with one headline and one sub-label
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 view with the garment on the left half, soft paper-cut cloud shapes and one flat sun shape floating in the upper field. Soft front-left key light with gentle wrap, soft contact shadow. Pastel cloud-blue background #C9E5EF. The product occupies 50-60%. Generous negative space on the right 38% for copy, with a headline zone reading 「{selling_point_1}」 in deep navy #2B3A67 and a small sub-label 「{selling_point_2}」. Negative: no more than one claim, no fabricated fabric or efficacy claims, no fiber-content percentages, no recognizable child face, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no watermark, no fake logo, no price tags.

shots.intent: 放大家长对洗后起球褪色的担忧并给出视觉反差

shots.lighting: left panel flat harsh dull light, right panel soft clean light
shots.textZone: small label zone at the lower corner of each panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen with two matched panels, identical straight-on camera and framing on both sides. Left panel: a faded, pilled generic children's garment lying limp under flat harsh light to visualize the fear of washing wear. Right panel: {product} crisp, vivid and neatly pressed under soft clean light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Pale warm-grey background #EDEDEA on both panels. The product occupies 50-60% per panel. No extra whitespace. A small label 「{callout_1}」 on the left panel and 「{callout_2}」 on the right panel in deep navy #2B3A67. Negative: no fabricated test data or percentages, no brand comparison, no exaggerated damaged garment beyond believable washing wear, no recognizable child face, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no watermark, no extra text.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 主题首屏为女童粉蓝格纹短袖连衣裙上身穿戴图（源图面部已打码）加面料理由云朵框配棉花与棉篮图；P2 三层结构圆图（表层/夹层/里层）、母婴合影理由图、商品信息开头；P3 商品参数（尺码100/110/120/130/140、季节夏）、修身/厚度/弹力/柔软四项指数条、售后承诺横幅、裙长/肩宽/胸围/袖长尺码表与温馨提示；P4 黄墙木牌道具的平铺正反面挂拍、蕾丝边与纽扣两格微距、模特展示开头；P5 白色欧式室内多张上身图、蓝色波点同款第二色与草帽、黄色老爷车道具；P6 室内上身图与小黑板道具；P7 波浪蕾丝娃娃领微距（领口细节）；P8 胸前压褶工艺微距与袖口微距；P9 袖筒走线微距与波浪花边下摆微距；P10 色差/尺码/发货三栏购物须知与卡通儿童装饰。品类判定：尺码为100-140儿童身高段，尺码表列为裙长/肩宽/胸围/袖长，成品为配鞋帽外穿的连衣裙而非贴身睡衣家居服，判为母婴/童装/女童格纹短袖连衣裙，与夹名一致。源页P2三层保暖夹层说法与P1/P3夏季短袖薄款自相矛盾，两说均不写入；面料成分与克重数值一律不写，尺码表实测数值改为留空表格单元，售后与发货时效承诺不搬运。已剥离：原店铺字样与促销价签、货号、模特面容与母婴合影（改为通用儿童模特背影/颈部以下裁切/无面裙模）、第三方卡通狗形象贴片、木牌上的第三方英文字样、黑板英文装饰文案与英文口号；产品一律以 {product} 占位，图内中文全部以「」占位符表达。
